title: Drupal 11 API reference is branch-scoped
summary: The Drupal 11 API reference is authoritative for Drupal 11.x API reference material and is generated from comments embedded in Drupal source code.

sources.locator: Welcome to the Drupal API Documentation!
sources.title: drupal - 11.x

drupal_core.notes: This source is explicitly scoped to the Drupal 11.x API reference.

version_applicability.notes: Do not apply Drupal 11.x API entries to Drupal 10.x or future branches without version-specific evidence.

actions: Use Drupal 11.x API records only when the project profile establishes Drupal 11.x applicability.
checks: Confirm the project Drupal core version before selecting Drupal 11 API guidance.
automation_hints: A future resolver should filter API records by Drupal core branch before stage selection.

enforcement.rationale: This record controls applicability selection and is not itself a build blocker.
